claims.detail: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 門 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *mɯns): phonetic 門 (OC *mɯːn) + semantic 口.
Exoactive derivation of 聞 (OC *mɯn, “to hear”) with suffix *-s, literally "let (me) hear" (Schuessler, 2007). See there for more.

etymology: Hội ý theo dạng gốc 圖: ⿴囗啚. Có bất đồng giữa nguồn; các claim được giữ nguyên trong bảng Formation.

claims.detail: Pictograph of a map of territory.

Ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意): 囗 (“walled city”) + 啚.
啚 is the early form of 鄙 (OC *prɯʔ, “remote areas”), thus meaning “territory”.
Related to 度 (OC *daːɡs, *daːɡ, “degree, measure”); see there for more (STEDT).

claims.detail: Simplified form of 國.  Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 或 represents the sound.
Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 或 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kʷɯːɡ): semantic 囗 (“closure”) + phonetic 或 (OC *ɡʷɯːɡ).
The k-prefix derivation of 域 (OC *ɢʷrɯɡ, “boundary; territory”). Cognate with 閾 (OC *qʰʷrɯɡ, “threshold”) and 囿 (OC *ɢʷɯs, *ɡʷɯ, “park; garden”).

claims.detail: Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 袁 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *ɢʷan): semantic 囗 (“fence”) + phonetic 袁 (OC *ɢʷan).
Borrowed from Tocharian B wänt-, Tocharian A wänt- (“to envelop, to surround”).
